item.title: 2026-W32 — IGRM Weekly Assessment: Week ending 6 August 2026
item.description: IGRM Weekly Assessment: Week ending 6 August 2026 Executive assessment Aggregate press salience moderated over the week without normalising. The seven-day composite ended at 61.5, against 67.5 on 30 July, a decline of 6.0 points. item.title: 2026-W31
item.description: The largest movement in this week's data was also the easiest to misread. The China/Eastern Border channel rose by 59.8 percentile points, yet the underlying news flow was dominated not by military escalation but by diplomacy.
